mcq.q: How is the Arabic word الْجُمُعَةُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: الْجُمُعَةُ is read al-jumuʿa and means Friday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I visit my grandmother on Friday."
mcq.explanation: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The lamp is above the table."
mcq.explanation: الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

mcq.q: Which reason best explains why we greet one another?
options: It is only needed at school
It is only needed by adults
It is only needed when we meet strangers
It shows respect and kindness to the person we meet
mcq.explanation: A greeting is for everyone. It shows that we see and respect the other person.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) mean?
mcq.explanation: كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "A gift for Amina."
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نِي?
mcq.explanation: نِي is read nii.

mcq.q: Which phrase would you say to a friend on a birthday?
mcq.explanation: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid means 'Happy birthday'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي (aghsilu wajhii) means: I wash my face.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مِلْعَقَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مِلْعَقَةٌ is read milʿaqa and means spoon.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "in"?
mcq.explanation: فِي (fii) means in.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ر?
mcq.explanation: The letter ر is called raa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) mean?
mcq.explanation: طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) means tomatoes.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable دَ?
mcq.explanation: دَ is read da.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "room"?
mcq.explanation: غُرْفَةٌ (ghurfa) means room.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word شَمْعَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: شَمْعَةٌ is read shamʿa and means candle.

mcq.q: What is phonological awareness?
mcq.explanation: Phonological awareness is being aware of the separate sounds in words.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mother"?
mcq.explanation: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بِ?
mcq.explanation: بِ is read bi.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) mean?
mcq.explanation: حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) means bag.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable سِ?
mcq.explanation: سِ is read si.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable تِ?
mcq.explanation: تِ is read ti.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Who is this? (a boy or man)"
mcq.explanation: مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "clouds"?
mcq.explanation: سَحَابٌ (sahaab) means clouds.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Monday"?
mcq.explanation: الِاثْنَيْنِ (al-ithnayn) means Monday.

mcq.q: What does the mark shadda tell you in the word umm?
options: The letter mim is said twice
mcq.explanation: A shadda doubles the sound of a letter, so we say um-m.

mcq.q: Which two letters begin the names of the days of the week in Arabic script (the word 'the')?
mcq.explanation: al- is written with alif and laam.

mcq.q: How does rain help people?
options: It helps crops to grow and gives us water
mcq.explanation: Rain waters crops and fills rivers and tanks.

mcq.q: What is a thematic word?
options: A word that belongs to the theme of a text
mcq.explanation: Thematic words belong to the main topic of a text.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Above the table there is a balloon."
mcq.explanation: فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

mcq.q: What does maa ajmala l-bii'a mean?
mcq.explanation: maa ajmala is a cry of wonder meaning 'how beautiful'.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word كَعْكَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: كَعْكَةٌ is read kaʿka and means cake.

mcq.q: Which is good body language for a speaker?
options: Standing straight and looking at the audience
mcq.explanation: Eye contact and a steady stance help the audience to listen.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "apples"?
mcq.explanation: تُفَّاحٌ (tuffaah) means apples.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) means potatoes.

mcq.q: What do the two little strokes at the end of شُكْرًا (shukran) create?
mcq.explanation: The double fatHa (tanwiin) gives the sound -an at the end of the word.

mcq.q: What is a good way to give peer feedback on reading?
options: Say what went well and give one tip to improve
mcq.explanation: Feedback should be honest and kind.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ mean?
options: Above the table there is a balloon.
mcq.explanation: الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
In the room there is a bed.
mcq.explanation: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ (baytii kabiir) means: My house is big.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) mean?
mcq.explanation: نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

mcq.q: What does the word mufiid mean?
mcq.explanation: mufiid means useful or good for you.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ (marhaban yaa Ahmad) means: Hello, Ahmad.

mcq.q: How do you say 'on Monday'?
mcq.explanation: yawma l-ithnayn means 'on the day of Monday'.

mcq.q: Which letter has one dot above it?
mcq.explanation: nuun has one dot above. Baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and yaa has two dots below.

mcq.q: Which Kiswahili word comes from the Arabic word kitaab?
mcq.explanation: The Kiswahili word kitabu (book) came from Arabic kitaab. The other words are Bantu words.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I clean my teeth."
mcq.explanation: أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مُفِيدٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مُفِيدٌ is read mufiid and means useful.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا رَأْسِي mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذَا رَأْسِي (haadhaa raʾsii) means: This is my head.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (alʿabu yawma s-sabt) means: I play on Saturday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "heart"?
mcq.explanation: قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ف make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ف makes the sound f as in fan.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word عَمَّةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: عَمَّةٌ is read ʿamma and means father's sister.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ mean?
options: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
May you be well every year.
mcq.explanation: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ (hal ʿindaka hafla?) means: Do you have a party? (to a boy)

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My sister is beautiful."
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) mean?
mcq.explanation: الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word الْخَمِيسُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: الْخَمِيسُ is read al-khamiis and means Thursday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ابْنٌ (ibn) mean?
mcq.explanation: ابْنٌ (ibn) means son.

mcq.q: What is a prediction?
options: A sensible guess about what will happen next
mcq.explanation: We use clues to predict what may happen next.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عِيدٌ (ʿiid) mean?
mcq.explanation: عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter د make?
mcq.explanation: The letter د makes the sound d as in dog.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word قَدَمٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: قَدَمٌ is read qadam and means foot.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) mean?
mcq.explanation: سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) means knife.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "carrots"?
mcq.explanation: جَزَرٌ (jazar) means carrots.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sunny"?
mcq.explanation: مُشْمِسٌ (mushmis) means sunny.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) mean?
mcq.explanation: شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) means hair.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable جَ?
mcq.explanation: جَ is read ja.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "on"?
mcq.explanation: عَلَى (ʿalaa) means on.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The pen is in the bag.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila) means: The book is on the table.

mcq.q: In a passage about the home, which of these is a theme word?
mcq.explanation: A theme word belongs to the topic. A chair is found in the home.

mcq.q: Which word means 'sun'?
mcq.explanation: shams means sun.

mcq.q: What does maadhaa mean?
mcq.explanation: maadhaa means what.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word لَذِيذٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: لَذِيذٌ is read ladhiidh and means delicious.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "good morning (the reply)"?
mcq.explanation: صَبَاحُ النُّورِ (sabaahu n-nuur) means good morning (the reply).

mcq.q: Which day name comes from the Arabic word for 'one'?
mcq.explanation: al-ahad, Sunday, is the first day.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ mean?
options: The pen is in the bag.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I eat rice."
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

mcq.q: Which letters can make a vowel long?
mcq.explanation: Alif, waaw and yaa lengthen a matching short vowel.

mcq.q: What does legible mean?
mcq.explanation: Legible writing can be read easily by other people.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word غَائِمٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: غَائِمٌ is read ghaa'im and means cloudy.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "father's brother"?
mcq.explanation: عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word رَقْصٌ (raqs) mean?
mcq.explanation: رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word صَحْنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: صَحْنٌ is read sahn and means plate.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ (ashrabu sh-shaaya) means: I drink tea.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ is read hadiyya and means gift.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I eat bread."
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَنْ هَذَا؟ mean?
options: Who is this? (a boy or man)
I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "birthday"?
mcq.explanation: عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ (ʿiid miilaad) means birthday.

mcq.q: What is a good way to give feedback on someone's handwriting?
options: Say something good first, then give one tip
mcq.explanation: Kind and helpful feedback encourages a friend to improve.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ك make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ك makes the sound k as in kite.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ (fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam) means: There are seven days in a week.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I have a brother and a sister'?
mcq.explanation: ʿindii means 'I have', akh is brother, wa is 'and' and ukht is sister.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) mean?
mcq.explanation: حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) means bathroom.

mcq.q: How many syllables are in the word kataba (ka-ta-ba)?
mcq.explanation: ka + ta + ba makes three syllables.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا جِسْمِي mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذَا جِسْمِي (haadhaa jismii) means: This is my body.

mcq.q: Which Arabic writing style is used in most printed books and newspapers?
mcq.explanation: Naskh is clear and round and is used for most printed books.

mcq.q: What does al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana mean?
options: The lamp is above the table.
The pen is in the bag.
The key is in the cupboard.
The chair is at the door.
mcq.explanation: miftaah is key and khizaana is cupboard.

mcq.q: Why are special occasions important for a community?
options: They bring people together and help them to live in peace
They are only for the rich
mcq.explanation: Celebrations bring families and friends together and build unity.
